message:
Please resume the shared authorization/security integration work needed by Truss. Your latest turn stopped with a platform error; treat the prepared-call diagnostic checks announced there as unfinished and preserve all existing source/evidence.

Truss's current checkpoint is 28d0786c on codex/refresh-helix-specs in /Users/erik/Projects/truss. Its Python source and fresh installed wheel pass119 tests with26 matching modules. Private PostgreSQL16.15 components include all four original INVOKER admission families, actual identity/ACL and denial checks, original epoch helper composition, typed snapshot prestate capture and nested cascade attribution. These do not establish protected ordinary-person admission or public engine APIs. All seven complete semantic native bodies/bindings and complete installed closure remain pending.

Please produce the closed, versioned owner handoff for: (1) original authenticated connecting person/subject, physical connection and transaction/attempt correspondence preserved across a privileged writer; (2) complete requirement-kind/occurrence/site/case assignment and current old/new effect authority, without fragment unions or caller-issued authority; (3) common exclusion order, coherent observation, configuration/epoch freshness, cancellation/unknown-outcome custody and publication closing/drain; (4) the exact supported native diagnostic/role/configuration subset and refusal behavior. Retain independently expected artifacts, required assumptions, actual native qualification and explicit unsupported cases. PostgreSQL17.9 component evidence must not be relabeled as Truss16.15, Aurora or Lakebase qualification.

The next joint exit is PA01–PA04: one original protected submission per admission family, correct connecting-person origin, ordinary private-registry denial, stale/refused zero-effects, preserved original context and qualified installed identity/ACL/dependency correspondence. PA05 then composes native event/prestate/guard/capacity/finalization/journal/settlement. Matching scalar OLD bytes cannot authenticate a substituted retained state's owner; original complete capture/context/scope correspondence must precede attribution. Consume Truss's existing operation context/artifact contracts and retain ownership separation rather than creating another compiler or policy resolver.

Start from Truss docs/helix/04-build/operation-ordinal-issuer-handoff.md and design-coordination.md and your current governing documents. Preserve peer changes. Publish only complete owner contracts/evidence that Truss can pin; identify unresolved interfaces precisely instead of advertising unfinished private APIs. No broader Truss scope or readiness flag is changed by this handoff.
